definitions.goal_complete: Frozen mission completion independently of contact
definitions.contact_run: At least one received-sample independent-solid contact episode
definitions.mission_failure: contact_run OR NOT goal_complete; union, not arithmetic sum
definitions.sample_sd: Sample standard deviation with denominator n-1
definitions.mapping_elapsed_s: Sum of recorded Total elapsed seconds in filtered [perf_row_start:perf_row_end)
definitions.mapping_mean: Unweighted arithmetic mean across runs; not pooled-frame mean
definitions.mapping_p95_ms: Linear empirical 95th percentile of per-frame Total, in milliseconds
definitions.mapping_window_frames_checked: main_mapping_window_frames excludes gate; gate_mapping_window_frames separate; mapping_window_frames is their sum
definitions.unavailable_optional_metrics: Blank unavailable means and n_available=0, not substituted zero
definitions.ack_latency_availability: Latency suppressed when corresponding raw ACK count is missing or zero; raw05 remains unchanged
definitions.separate_gate: 30 prerelease forest-gate flights excluded from main210 and main509 cycles
